title: appa-kagent-demo values
description: Constrains the agent names the chart renders into the policy and the Agent objects. Each one must be a DNS-1123 label: lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens, 63 characters at most. kagent maps only hyphens and slashes when it spells the agent-tool name, so a dotted subdomain name is refused here on purpose. Every other value passes unchecked.

childName.description: The python child cluster-ops delegates to. The policy names it <namespace>__NS__<childName>, hyphens as underscores.
The go child the go twin delegates to. The policy names it <namespace>__NS__<childName>, hyphens as underscores.

undeclaredName.description: The go agent the policy never names. Every delegation to it is denied.
